name: portfolio-simulator
description: React and FastAPI historical portfolio simulator for PPO risk buckets.

scripts.check:types: node scripts/run-with-timeout.mjs --timeout-ms 60000 -- node node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc -p client\tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false
scripts.test:client: node scripts/run-with-timeout.mjs --timeout-ms 60000 -- node node_modules\vitest\vitest.mjs run --root client --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:questionnaire: node scripts/run-with-timeout.mjs --timeout-ms 60000 --mkdir ..\tmp\portfolio-simulator-pytest -- ..\ranked-risk-model\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest ml-service\tests\test_core.py -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp ..\tmp\portfolio-simulator-pytest\questionnaire -k questionnaire
scripts.test: npm run check:types && npm run test:client && npm run test:ml
